action-prepare-rule: Free. Next Strike +{{n}}. Fails if struck.
bio-berserk: Strikes, and strikes harder once it is below half.
bio-leech: Prepares often. A clean hit heals it.
bio-liar: Its tells are almost always lies. Read them backwards.
bio-mimic: Half the time it does what you did last round.
bio-nullroot: The root process. Reads your habits, then turns savage at half. Mutates the rules every third round.
bio-oracle: Watches your last three moves and counters your habit.
bio-trainer: A training process. Its tells are always true.
bio-warden: A gatekeeper. Blocks often and rarely lies. Striking into its Block stings.
board-empty: No runs logged yet. Be the first.
board-offline: The board is unreachable right now.
first-visit: New here? The training duel teaches the whole loop in about two minutes.
help-charge: Commands cost Charge (+1 each round). Acting without enough is an overdraw: you act and lose 1 Integrity. Reinforce spends one more for a stronger Strike or Block.
help-keys: Keys: 1-3 stance · A Strike · S Block · D Prepare · F Probe · R reinforce.
help-round-body: Pick one of three stances, then a command. The Protocol has already chosen in secret and shows a tell: its intent, which may be a lie. Both moves flip, then resolve.
help-run-body: A run is {{n}} duels across five sectors. Integrity carries from duel to duel (a small patch between). After each of the first four sectors: one free script, then the black market. NULL//ROOT waits at the end.
help-score: Score: each duel won is worth 1,000 x its sector, plus Integrity left, a flawless bonus and speed. Pacts multiply it.
help-triangle: Strike beats Prepare. Block blunts Strike and leaves the striker Overextended. Prepare beats Block. Probe locks the next tell to the truth.
item-decoder-rule: Once per duel, learn whether a tell is true.
item-probe-rule: Probe locks two rounds, not one.
item-strike-rule: Your Strikes +1 for the rest of the run.
milestone-body: Pick one script to keep for the rest of the run.
minigames-setting: Clash minigames (off: clashes resolve as rolled)
mod-chaos-rule: One side’s action is replaced at random.
mod-reveal-rule: The tell is the truth this round.
nudge-hint: Space or Brace to nudge toward center
pact-blackout-rule: No tell on even rounds. Score +{{n}}%.
pact-chaos-rule: Mutations and glitches twice as often. Score +{{n}}%.
pact-double-rule: Every Strike on both sides +1. Score +{{n}}%.
patch-note: Field patch: +{{n}} Integrity before the next duel.
press-zone-aria: Press when the indicator is in the zone
reinforce: Reinforce (+{{n}} Charge): Strike +1, or Block takes no chip and reflects 1
rule-bastion: When you take damage, it takes {{n}}.
rule-pressure: Strike into a Block deals {{n}} and you stay balanced.
rule-read: Prepare holds even when struck (hit -{{n}}); a held Prepare gives +{{c}} Charge.
rule-scan: Probe is free, gives +{{c}} Charge and locks two rounds.
shop-body: Fragments are spent here or lost when the run ends.
signed-out-note: Runs, scores and achievements need an account. The training duel does not.
submit-failed: The run could not be logged.
submit-signed-out: Sign in to log runs on the board.
tagline: Read the rogue Protocols, call their bluffs, and reach the root.
title: Cursed Logic
tut-block: Now Block. A Strike into your Block deals nothing and leaves it Shaken.
tut-intro: TRAINER.tmp is a harmless process. Each round you pick a stance, then a command. It picks in secret, but shows a tell: its intent. Real Protocols lie. This one does not.
tut-nudge: Not that one: use the highlighted control.
tut-outro: Done. A run is nine duels across five sectors; Integrity carries between them. Learn who lies, buy scripts in the black market, and reach NULL//ROOT.
tut-prepare: Prepare. It costs nothing, and your next Strike gets +2. It fails if you are struck.
tut-probe: Probe. It trades this round for the truth: the next two tells are locked to what it will do.
tut-stance-commit: It is about to Prepare (charge up). Pick Commit: Strike +2.
tut-stance-guard: Its tell says Strike. Pick Guard: your Block will take no chip.
tut-stance-read: Its locked tell: a glitch, it will do nothing. Pick Read.
tut-stance-scan: Pick Scan: Probe becomes free and gives Charge back.
tut-strike-finish: Primed, committed: Strike to terminate it.
tut-strike-prepare: Strike. Hitting a Prepare interrupts it for extra damage.
victory-body: NULL//ROOT is down. The terminal is yours.
